rules: Every proposed service links to its source process, activity and business rules.
Search the existing catalog first; suggest updating a service rather than duplicating it.
Missing owners, SLAs, eligibility or targets are flagged as unresolved — never fabricated.
Source version and draft version are preserved, so a To-Be change can trigger a service review.
Process owner validates the service; service owner confirms commitments; governance approves publication.
A structured, schema-validated record — not a paragraph of free text.

pipeline.d: To-Be activities · owners · roles · business rules · proposed KPIs · systems
Identify candidates · group activities · draft definitions · propose inputs, outputs, SLAs
Completeness · duplicates · evidence links · ownership · confidence flags
Owner validates the service · confirms commitments · authorises publication
Approved definitions · channels · SLAs · KPIs · automation opportunities

catalog_types: Supplier onboarding · equipment mobilisation · employee onboarding
Access request · application support · device provisioning
Validate requisition · approve PO · reconcile cost

patterns.name: Purchase Requisition Review
patterns.description: Validate the completeness of a purchase requisition and route it for the appropriate next step.
patterns.inputs: Requisition ref · business justification · budget line · supporting docs
patterns.output: Validated requisition, or a request for corrections

patterns.source_activity: Release PO at the agreed framework rate
patterns.name: Purchase Order Issuance
patterns.description: Release an approved purchase order against the agreed framework / contract rate.
patterns.output: Released purchase order at the agreed rate

patterns.name: Supplier Delivery Confirmation & Expediting
patterns.description: Confirm committed delivery dates and expedite at-risk or long-lead orders against the site schedule.
patterns.trigger: On PO release or delivery-risk flag
patterns.inputs: PO ref · delivery schedule · site need-by date
patterns.output: Confirmed delivery date, or a recovery action

patterns.name: Purchase Order Change Request
patterns.description: Request a controlled amendment to an existing purchase order (quantity, price or schedule).
patterns.trigger: On a change need against a live PO
patterns.inputs: PO ref · change reason · approval evidence

patterns.name: Goods Receipt & 3-Way Match
patterns.reason: Executed system-to-system as an internal control step within PO delivery — not independently requestable. Keep it as a process activity; its performance is already measured by the PO KPIs.

patterns.name: PO Closure & Vendor Performance
patterns.reason: Overlaps an existing "Order Administration / Closure" service in the current catalog — recommend updating that record rather than creating a duplicate (reuse-before-create).

patterns.name: Sourcing Request (RFx)
patterns.description: Request a sourcing event (RFx) for a defined package, issued to approved suppliers via the portal.
patterns.inputs: Package scope · technical spec · approved supplier list · timeline

patterns.name: Technical Evaluation (TCS)
patterns.description: Evaluate supplier technical submittals against the specification and produce the Technical Compliance Sheet.
patterns.owner_note: Technical Evaluation function — not in approved owner data
patterns.automation: AI evaluation agent drafts the TCS; engineers sign off exceptions

patterns.name: Supplier Qualification
patterns.description: Qualify a new supplier (registration, compliance, financial screening) before they can be invited.
patterns.output: Qualified supplier or a rejection with reason

patterns.name: Quotation Intake & Logging
patterns.reason: An internal intake step inside the Sourcing Request service — not separately requestable. Keep as a process activity.
